capabilities.name: Explicit adapter registration
capabilities.description: Registers trusted in-process adapter objects after validating unique IDs and capability declarations.

capabilities.name: Policy-gated tool invocation
capabilities.description: Requires an injected policy decision for each invocation and rejects missing or denied decisions.

capabilities.name: Bounded JSON-compatible payloads
capabilities.description: Validates JSON-compatible input and output and enforces configurable serialized byte limits.

explicit_non_capabilities: AIX codec or transport gateway integration
timeouts or cancellation of blocking adapters
automatic tool discovery or dynamic code loading
